purpose: Original management-view sprites for People, Bases, Stores, Leadership, Captives and Media; discoverable organisation workflows.
style_reference: assets/runtime-art/source/journal_icons_v1.png and assets/runtime-art/source/journal_network_emblem_v1.png inspected for painterly palette and material consistency; the new atlas was generated from a self-contained prompt.
rights_provenance: Original artwork generated for this project with built-in image generation. No external branding, embedded text, or original-game bitmap is shipped.

assets.source_postprocessing: None. The selected built-in PNG output was copied unchanged. The original transparent alpha channel is preserved.
assets.generation_history: A fresh six-icon atlas was generated, then edited through built-in image generation to improve cell spacing and eliminate object overlap across cell boundaries. The intermediate draft is not shipped.
assets.geometry_contract: Row-major exact 512×512 cells on a 1536×1024 canvas. All meaningful alpha is contained within the intended cell; edge alpha is at most 1/255. Use rectangular cell crops. Labels, counts, warning states and controls remain live Flutter widgets. Recommended 32–48px display; cropping to each meaningful bounding box with extra transparent padding is optional for equal apparent size.

cells.description: Overlapping painted portrait contact cards and brass clip.
Olive safehouse, warm window and old brass key.
Wooden supply crates with folded fabric and an olive canister.
Three portrait cards connected by brass hierarchy rods.
Closed brass padlock and strapped olive folio.
Black and brass typewriter with a blank cream sheet.

assets.visual_review: All six sprites were inspected in the generated output. Each subject is whole and unclipped, with a distinct silhouette and no baked labels. PIL inspection confirmed RGBA transparency and no meaningful alpha on exact cell edges. The warm RGB tint visible in some previews beneath alpha=0 is transparent data, not a baked background.
assets.role: Decorative management navigation and section emblems only. No gameplay data or interaction is encoded in the artwork.
